value.rationale: The smallest inconsistent data set with fresh random epochs isolates a real distinction between evaluation at epoch boundaries and at intermediate updates. The exact parameter where an improvement becomes a penalty at the intermediate phase is useful when interpreting stationary comparisons that report only an endpoint or a time average. The example defeats inference of a per-phase ordering from a favorable epoch-boundary result, without claiming a general ordering, and contributes more than a recomputation of known IID variance.
